items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: that's when they brought Buddy Rich.

ctx.x: Well, I didn't have no problem. I tell you why I didn't have no problems, because, just like I say, I played the marriage. Nobody else like me. I'm creative. I imagine. The reason why I create the marriage, because I marry different way. I've got my Afro-Cuban rhythm already set. I ain't got no drummer there banging jazz.

All I had to do was bring the jazz (inaudible). You play what you want, and that's that. So he don't have to conflict with the rhythm. He only had (inaudible). We had one five men solid playing one rhythm. And we tried to play (inaudible) rhythm, my rhythm. (Inaudible) get ready with your -- your arrangement and your bass and (inaudible). And we didn't let him change my basses. My bass played the rhythm. They played -- that's when they brought Buddy Rich. I said, the only way we can do this, bring put him in the…
